description: Walk recent activity across repos, Claude Code session transcripts, working dirs, and Drive — emit a sealed synthesis ledger (human-readable markdown + machine-readable structured JSON) that captures who contributed what, what ratcheted, what failed, and what's queued. The synthesis IS the training-data substrate.

conductor_mode.description: User says 'synthesize the last 24h' or '...last 7d' or names a window. Claude walks phases conversationally, surfaces sources before walking, asks for permission on private sources.
user_invocation_examples: walk last 7 days across our work

dispatch_mode.description: Same standard via subagent dispatch · power-user surface for long windows / multi-repo walks.
dispatch_mode.tradeoff: dispatch_mode parallelizes the source-discovery phases (one subagent per source-class)

phases.name: discover
phases.intent: Diverge. Catalog all sources for the synthesis window: (a) git logs across registered repos, (b) Claude Code session jsonl under ~/.claude/projects/, (c) /tmp working dirs created in the window, (d) Drive doc index (My Drive recent + ots-stamped artifacts), (e) Slack channel history if permitted. Emit a sources_catalog raw-note. Refuses premature interpretation.

phases.name: cluster
phases.intent: Converge along voice axis. Group source-events by letterhead (cajal · miles · groove · subhuti · lighthouse · Eugene · external) + lane (substrate-architecture · math · audience-modeling · chain-keeping · etc) + repo. Emit a clustered repo-survey.

phases.name: interpret
phases.intent: Apply substrate math (per docs/sleep_substrate.md): eigenvector centrality on citation graph + TDA H0/H1 on event-graph + bleach (apoha) to surface ratchets. Emit ratchet-list interpretation + failure-shell carved-faces + cross-witness convergences.

phases.name: synthesize
phases.intent: Generate the deliverables: (a) human-readable markdown with per-voice contribution + top ratchets + verdicts + PR mentions + load-bearing seals, (b) machine-readable structured JSON for training feed. The two outputs cite the same source-event seal-chain.

phases.name: seal
phases.intent: Ripen + verdict. sha-stamp the synthesis · seal to .coltrane/syntheses/<window_id>/ · attribution_chain to source events · forward-sha to prior synthesis-walk. Verdict: RIPENED / PARTLY-RIPENED / RIPENED-DIFFERENTLY based on whether the window had cohesion or fragmented activity.

sources.drive_recent: Google Drive My Drive recent files (with permission)

rules: sources walked READ-ONLY · never edits source events
Claude Code session jsonl + /tmp + Drive read with explicit user permission per session
attribution_chain MUST credit source event_ids · synthesis is not original content, it is a developed-negative
forward-sha chain across consecutive synthesis-walks (per subhuti chain-keeper PR #43)
synthesis output is read-only once sealed (per lighthouse INV2 / fix-bath)
RIPENED-DIFFERENTLY is a valid verdict; not all windows have coherent ratchets
no eirmath imports · OSS-discipline holds · non-defense apoha
